overall_summary: Deduplication and recent performance analysis reveal a strong audience preference for extreme astronomical 'What-If' scenarios and bizarre planetary conditions. Specifically, videos employing the 'What If You Fell Into...' hook combined with extreme cosmic objects (such as liquid diamond planets, dark planets, and burning ice) generated the highest views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes-per-view) over the past 7 days. Standard static fact lists are underperforming compared to interactive, immersive hypothetical scenarios.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) achieved over 900-1000+ views rapidly with high like ratios (38 and 18 likes respectively) within the recent 7-day window.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical space disaster and extreme planetary immersion scenarios. Use titles starting with 'What If You Fell Into...' paired with visually striking, counter-intuitive destinations.

winning_patterns.evidence: Content focusing on bizarre planetary mechanics like 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (v1rrcZLdp4U) pulled strong engagement (~700-1000 views, 25-36 likes).
winning_patterns.action: Continue producing short-form segments on extreme astrophysics focusing on weird weather, hyper-dense materials, or anomalies that defy normal physics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A, 5 views) and 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head' (ef3ND4qiRHc, 71 views) stalled completely compared to the space content published in the same timeframe.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from generic psychology/brain-hack shorts unless framed inside a high-stakes, narrative-driven scenario.

weak_patterns.evidence: Basic animal facts such as 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (AXAfwrzzEdU, 1Bm0zw_qAAg) had mediocre traction when presented without a cinematic survival or extreme comparison hook.
weak_patterns.action: If doing animal content, strictly leverage the cinematic animal survival or extreme comparative angle (e.g., survival mechanics under extreme pressure) rather than simple trivia.
